title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(三上明義研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III (Mikami Akiyoshi)
keywords: Electronic Display 2.Flexible Display 3.Organic EL Device 4.Optical Theory 5.Computer Simulation
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) learn basic knowledge in electronics and optics. (2) learn engineering application ability and research promotion ability.
advice: We will cover the following materials: 1. Basic research on high performance organic EL display 2. Basic research on high performance organic thin film solar cells 3. Research and development of flexible plastic light-emitting films for lighting Based on these research themes and existing results, we will actively conduct research activities aiming at new developments in technologies regarding organic light-emitting devices and their optical analysis for the purpose of the next-generation information displays.
books: Textbooks:Text and documents will be distributed as appropriate during class Reference books:None Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: Review basic knowledge such as electromagnetism, optoelectronics, electronic physics, display engineering. Practical skills in electronic circuits and programming are also required.

activityGoals.body: Be able to propose research objectives, experimental methods and plans.
Be able to explain the technical issues and possibilities related to the research theme.
Be able to discuss information on research activities and to perform original research
Be able to present research results at the group meeting.
Be able to make a project report.
